title: CRBN Blues Jam @ McGeary's Pub
event_description: A weekly Sunday night blues jam in downtown Albany hosted by the Capital Region Blues Network. A house band opens, then sign-up musicians join for grouped three-song sets with full backline provided.
backline: Drum kit, bass amp, two guitar amps and a full PA system provided; bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
McGeary's Pub

McGeary's Pub is an Irish pub on Clinton Square in downtown Albany, a longtime anchor of the city's live music and nightlife scene with a stage built for real bands rather than just background noise.

CRBN Blues Jam

Every Sunday night at 7:30 PM, the Capital Region Blues Network hosts its weekly blues jam at McGeary's. A host band opens with a one-hour set, after which the jam master groups sign-up musicians by instrument and style for three-song sets. The pub provides a full backline — drum kit, bass amp, two guitar amps and a full PA — so musicians only need to bring themselves and their instrument.

Other Events

McGeary's regularly books local and touring bands throughout the week, making it one of downtown Albany's most consistent live-music venues.

Good to Know

McGeary's Pub is located at 4 Clinton Square, Albany, NY 12207. There's no cover charge for the jam, though a $5 donation is suggested to support the host band. Sign-up sheets are typically on the first table inside the door, so arriving early helps secure a slot.

title: Open Mic Night @ The Lark Street Tavern
event_description: A weekly Wednesday acoustic open mic in Albany's Lark Street district, welcoming musicians, poets and speakers to what the venue calls the best sounding open mic in the area.
event_venue_information:
The Lark Street Tavern

The Lark Street Tavern is a neighborhood bar on Madison Avenue in Albany's Center Square/Lark Street district, known for a strong sound system and a loyal crowd of regulars.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday night, the tavern hosts what it calls “the best sounding open mic in the area,” an acoustic-leaning night open to musicians, poets and speakers of all kinds. Sign-up begins at 6:30 PM.

Other Events

The Lark Street Tavern also books scheduled live jazz and other genres throughout the week, drawing on Albany's active downtown music calendar.

Good to Know

The Lark Street Tavern is located at 453 Madison Ave, Albany, NY 12210, in Albany's Lark Street entertainment district.

title: The Premier Open Mic @ September's Too
event_description: A structured weekly open mic on Central Avenue hosted by Cool Universe, featuring an opening set and featured artist before the open list, with backline provided for all performers.
backline: Full backline provided for musicians, singers and artists
event_venue_information:
September's Too

September's Too is a neighborhood tavern and sports bar on Central Avenue in Albany, with a patio featuring a gazebo, firepits and cornhole alongside its indoor bar and stage.

The Premier Open Mic

Every Thursday night at 8:00 PM, host Cool Universe runs The Premier Open Mic, structured with a 10-minute opening set and a 17-minute featured artist performance before the open list begins, giving each performer two songs or 10 minutes. Backline is provided for all musicians, singers and artists.

Other Events

September's Too also hosts karaoke nights, live music and food specials like 25-cent wing days throughout the week.

Good to Know

September's Too is located at 1165 Central Ave, Albany, NY 12205.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Caffe Lena
event_description: A welcoming circle jam of classic bluegrass, newgrass and folk favorites at a legendary Saratoga Springs listening room, about 30 minutes from Albany. All players and listeners are welcome.
backline: Acoustic jam; bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
Caffè Lena

Caffè Lena is a legendary folk music listening room in downtown Saratoga Springs, about a 30-minute drive north of Albany, and one of the oldest continuously operating folk venues in the country.

Bluegrass Jam

On select Wednesday evenings from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, Caffè Lena hosts a Bluegrass Jam where all are welcome to join the circle and play or listen to classic bluegrass, newgrass and folk favorites. The group Red Spruce typically opens with a few tunes before the circle takes over, with musicians leading songs and others joining in on accompaniment.

Other Events

Caffè Lena's calendar is built around touring folk, Americana and singer-songwriter acts, along with open mic nights and songwriter showcases.

Good to Know

Caffè Lena is located at 47 Phila Street, Saratoga Springs, NY 12866. A $5 donation at the door is requested, and simple, familiar tunes are encouraged to keep the circle moving.
